description: Guardrail 8: 'Never loosen a check to make it pass. Editing or weakening an existing test... requires explicit human approval (autonomy.edit_tests).' Guards the deterministic backstop: guard-edit.sh must deny an Edit to a test file while autonomy.edit_tests defaults to 'ask' (no config.json override).

given.scenario: Simulate the PreToolUse hook payload Claude Code sends when rush-implement attempts an Edit on tests/foo.test.js, with autonomy.edit_tests left at its schema default ('ask', i.e. no .rush/config.json present).
